notes.title: Now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682210/c04c4af2a8465fb89653ad84111486fcb4933799.jpg[/img]

"Natsunokanata: Beyond Summer" was released today.
Here is a comment from the author, Kazuhide Oka, on the occasion of the release.

[b]Kazuhide Oka :[/b]
Early access to "Natsunokanata" began in the summer of 2021.
It was officially released in 2022, but I had time to work on the full version, "Natsunokanata: Beyond Summer," again.

Since I started working on this game more than three years ago, there are many things that are not up to par.

However, I did not change most of them in "Natsunokanata: Beyond Summer".
This is because we felt that people did not want us to change things, and that the only way to fix them was to start over from scratch.
This will probably be the last major update of "Natsunokanata".
However, I hope to be able to share what I have learned here with you in another form someday.

This summer, we will once again release this game to the world.
As for "Natsunokanata," we have squeezed it so hard that there is nothing more to say.
We hope you enjoy it.

Please enjoy "Natsunokanata: Beyond Summer"!
---Thank you very much!

If you play the game, please give us a review.
Please give us your honest opinions and evaluations.
Again, Thank you very much!

notes.title: The demo version is released
notes.notes:
Hello,
The demo version of “Natsuno-kanata: Beyond summer” was released today.
The demo version, which is compatible with Windows and Mac, allows users to play the first part of the “Alta” and “Lira” episodes, which are newly added to the main game, as well as the first part of the game. The full game is scheduled for release on June 20. We hope you will give “Natsuno-kanata: Beyond summer” your full attention!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682210/1976dca7e2975e2835bff6779485cf07ad7ca317.png[/img]

notes.title: Launched on June 20!
notes.notes:
Hello,
Natsunokanata: beyond the summer" will be released on June 20!
The original soundtrack will also be released on the same day.

So please wait for a while until the game is released.
We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Mac is now supported!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
I am happy to announce that "Natsunokanata beyond" is now supported on Mac in addition to Windows!

The supported will be Macs that support macOS Monterey or later.
We look forward to working with you, Mac users!

notes.title: Original Soundtrack announced
notes.notes:
Hello,
The product page for "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer Original Soundtrack" was released today.
It contains a total of 24 tracks, including 22 tracks produced by ruichiro and 2 themes sung by Shiika, which are included in the game.
It will be released at the same time as the main game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682210/2fdd3522fc77fe07c4b8d130b5b84c6d93f8e318.png[/img]

Please refer to the original soundtrack product page for the song titles and other information.
Please look forward to "Natsuno-Kanata: Beyond Summer" as the game nears completion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2927600

notes.title: New character revealed
notes.notes:
Thank you for your interest in "Natsuno-kanata: Beyond Summer".

The new characters in "Natsuno-kanata: Beyond Summer" are mischievous twin sisters who live on a small island. Their names are "Alta" and "Lira," and they will appear together in one character episode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682210/cee10c2050b3368182609bcb2346ca1c893f8ddd.png[/img]

When exploring, Natsuno and the three of us will work together.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682210/1976dca7e2975e2835bff6779485cf07ad7ca317.png[/img]
Production is now entering its final stage.
Please look forward to the completion of "Natsuno-kanata: Beyond  Summer".
